import re
from datetime import datetime

access_token = apis.file_system.login(username='ja-solomon@gmail.com', password='fT204^N')['access_token']
now=datetime.now(); year=now.year
all_files = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path='~/bills/', entry_type='files', recursive=True)

# electricity files for current year
el_year_files=[f for f in all_files if '/bills/electricity/' in f and f.startswith(f'/home/james/bills/electricity/{year}-')]

# derive months from filenames
month_re=re.compile(r'/electricity/(\d{4})-(\d{2})\.(txt|pdf)$')
months=set()
for f in el_year_files:
    m=month_re.search(f)
    if m:
        months.add((int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))))
print('electricity_year_files_count', len(el_year_files))
print('unique_months', sorted(list(months)))

# Use txt files only to avoid double-counting pdf+txt for same month
el_txt=[f for f in el_year_files if f.endswith('.txt')]
print('electricity_txt_files_count', len(el_txt))

el_txt_sorted=sorted(el_txt)

def extract_total(content):
    m=re.search(r'Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', content, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    return float(m.group(1)) if m else None

items=[]
for fp in el_txt_sorted:
    content = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=fp, access_token=access_token)['content']
    total=extract_total(content)
    items.append((fp,total))
    print('file', fp.split('/')[-1], 'total', total)

sum_total=sum(t for _,t in items if t is not None)
print('sum_total', sum_total)

# complete task
apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer=sum_total)
